issues.description: try_traverse_and_lock_subtree_root discards PageTableGuard values on two traversal paths without manually releasing their underlying spin locks.
issues.rationale: PageTableGuard contains an optional SpinGuard but has no active Drop implementation; normal_drop is the path that invokes normal_unlock. The present-PTE branch clears cur_node_guard at line 386, and the absent-PTE branch lets pt_guard leave scope after its non-returning paths, without calling normal_drop. Either path can retain the node lock and block a later acquisition. Repair d45f4d70 explicitly releases both guards and preserves in_protocol across the relevant writes.
issues.source_evidence:

lines 381-419
blob 8bfd5e943ea47793c0da63436ec243cace04414d
The carried guard is cleared at line 386 and the local pt_guard reaches the branch end at line 419 without normal_drop.

The repair takes and normal-drops the carried guard, normal-drops pt_guard at the end of the other branch, and preserves in_protocol in the write contracts.
issues.verification: Fixed-source guard-lifetime analysis and direct repair-diff adjudication by two reviewers. Historical Rust/Verus was not executed.
